helper_source_review.metadata: The exact existing module-cache or fixed /prefetched-proxy mod/zip bytes seed a fresh metadata download without copying .info or ziphash. Fresh-cache download forces the official Go proxy; shared-cache revalidation retains the Dockerfile existing fixed file proxy plus official proxy. Both require official sumdb, pinned module/source sums and exact Git Origin verification. Only complete Go-produced .info is copied, and external receipts remain outside the final runtime stage.
helper_source_review.graph_capture: Read-only go list -deps -export primes export metadata, verifies source lock hashes before/after and calls the original unchanged capture helper with the same package, plugin tags and GOWORK contract. It does not filter graph fields or change the prior capture command.
helper_source_review.web_boundary: The new helper is copied only to /tools in the plugins and build stages. The separate scratch evidence target copies only /external-evidence. The final source-runtime stage is byte-identical, and there is no new frontend build, HTTP route, Web context or HTML serving path.
helper_source_review.separate_native_review_required: New actual full image/native/source graph/scan identity is adjudicated separately. This addendum does not preapprove the new Grafana subject, assert cache experiments or image scans passed, or declare runtime bytes unchanged.
